Extract from Newspaper.
Deportation of Caftens.

The Chief of Police addressed the following dispatch
to the Minister of Justice on the 30th of last month.
The nefarious industry of lechery which has been
constantly and peristently suppressed by the Police in
former years has again appeared in our midst and is
being excercised openly.
From close examinations which I have held, I have
ascertained who are the caftens, their names and nationalities.
They continue to speculate in this business and employ the
most detestable means sometimes coupled with threats.
Poor women through privation and misery fall easily into
their hands.
As with their predecessors they who were ordered away
in the past, so with the present offenders: they are
also Foreigners.
This shameful industry is no doubt a crime which
is punishable under Artl 278 of the Criminal Code but with
your knowledge of things you will readily understand that
the institution of proceedings by jury to stop the crime
of lechery is undesirable as it would get publicity and
that would affect the public morals of the nation.

The caftens a list of whose names I enclose, are
well known. They are one and all of Foreign nationality
and therefore liable to be deported. The Government
therefore by these means can get rid of the obnoxious
scoundrels.
It is not ignored that deportation is a
soverign right the use of which is not seriously disputed
by an independent nation that has the liberty of expelling
from amongst its people troublesome intruders that cause
danger and lead the public morals into shame I therefore
request that you will deport those referred to in the list.
In accordance with the requisition the Chief of
the Police was authorised to deport the persons mentioned
in the 1st of whom the following have already been
arrested:-

Bernardo Gultzer, S. Gaufman, Joko Harenoces,
Adolpho Macobs, Nathan Honstack, Hasson Capelam,
H. Goldenberg, Jacob Hahenarberg, William Weehl,
Israel Netseber, Leopoldo Einsten, Daniel
Frankien, Adolph Selerston, Rosa Steinger,
Canton Joseph, Jacob Buzinsky, Cecilia Hungare,
Hermann Kaimer, Adolpho Toppelberg, Harois Catinger,
Moritz Ohelar and Emma Rapere.

The caftens were arrested yesterday at 6 p.m. and
sent to the House of Detention.

I. O. 4870
（印：签 4/10 5/12/22）

报纸摘录。
驱逐鸨母（Caftens）。

警务处长于上月30日向司法部长发出如下电文：
卖淫这一邪恶行当，虽经警方往年持续且坚决地取缔，但如今又在我们中间出现，并公然进行。
经过我进行的严密调查，我已查明谁是鸨母，以及他们的姓名和国籍。
他们继续在此行业中牟利，有时甚至采用威胁等最令人憎恶的手段。贫困妇女因匮乏和苦难，极易落入他们手中。
正如过去被勒令离境的前辈一样，目前的违法者也是外国人。
这种可耻的行当无疑是《刑法典》第278条规定应受惩罚的罪行，但凭您对时事的了解，您会 readily 理解，通过陪审团提起诉讼来制止卖淫罪是不可取的，因为这会引起公众关注，进而影响国家的公共道德。

我所附名单上的鸨母均系知名人物。他们全是外国国籍，因此可能被驱逐出境。因此，政府可以通过这些手段摆脱这些令人厌恶的无赖。
不可否认，驱逐出境是一项主权权利，其使用并未受到一个独立国家的严重争议，该国有权从人民中驱逐造成危险并使公共道德蒙羞的麻烦入侵者。因此，我请求您将名单中所指之人驱逐出境。
根据要求，警务处长获准驱逐名单中提及的人员，其中以下人员已被逮捕：-

Bernardo Gultzer, S. Gaufman, Joko Harenoces,
Adolpho Macobs, Nathan Honstack, Hasson Capelam,
H. Goldenberg, Jacob Hahenarberg, William Weehl,
Israel Netseber, Leopoldo Einsten, Daniel
Frankien, Adolph Selerston, Rosa Steinger,
Canton Joseph, Jacob Buzinsky, Cecilia Hungare,
Hermann Kaimer, Adolpho Toppelberg, Harois Catinger,
Moritz Ohelar 和 Emma Rapere。

这些鸨母于昨日下午6时被逮捕，并被送往拘留所。

Deportation of Caftens.

The Chief of Police addressed to the Minister of Justice on
the 30th of last month, the following despatch:-
"The nefarious industry of lechery that has been stubborn
and constantly abused by the police during the former years
has again reappeared in our midst and is being exercised
openly.
"From the close examinations held by me I could find
out the caftens by their names and nationalities who continue
to expoluate, employing the most detestable means coupled
with threat, and the poor women, forced by privation
and misery, fall easily into their hands.
"As their predecessors that were ordered to retire in the
past, the actual ones are also foreigners.
"Their shameful industry is no doubt as a crime
punishable under Art. 278 of the criminal code.
"With your good knowledge of things, you will readily
understand that the institution of proceedings to stop the crime
of lockers before a jury, is undesirable, because it might get
publicity that will effect the public moral of the nation.
"The caftens, a list of which I enclose, are well known
and they are one and all of foreign nationalities, therefore
they are under the condition of being deported, since the
Government can get rid of these obnoxious scoundrels by
these means.
It is not ignored that deportation is a sovereign right,
the use of which is not seriously disputed with any independent
notion, that have liberty of expelling from its midst troublesome
intruders that cause danger and lead the public moral -
into shame. Therefore I request you to deport the strangers
in the list referred to!
In accordance with the requisition, the Chief of Police
was authorized to deport the persons contained in the list,
of whom the following have been already arrested: Bernard
Goldfar, S. Confmann, F. T.
The caftens were arrested at 6 p.m. without any
grounds of detention.

警务处长于上月30日向司法部长发出如下电文：-
“卖淫这一邪恶行当，在往年曾遭到警方的顽固且持续的打击，如今又在我们中间重新出现，并公然进行。
“经过我进行的严密调查，我已按姓名和国籍查明了鸨母，他们继续利用最可憎的手段并辅以威胁进行剥削，而贫困妇女因匮乏和苦难所迫，极易落入他们手中。
“正如过去被勒令退出的前辈一样，目前这些人也是外国人。
“他们的可耻行当无疑是根据《刑法典》第278条应受惩罚的罪行。
“凭您对时事的充分了解，您会 readily 理解，在陪审团面前提起诉讼以制止拉皮条（lockers）犯罪是不可取的，因为这可能会引起公众关注，从而影响国家的公共道德。
“我所附名单上的鸨母均系知名人物，且他们全是外国国籍，因此他们处于被驱逐的条件之下，因为政府可以通过这些手段摆脱这些令人厌恶的无赖。
不可否认，驱逐出境是一项主权权利，任何独立国家对其使用的争议都不大，这些国家有权从其中驱逐造成危险并使公共道德蒙羞的麻烦入侵者。因此，我请求您驱逐所指名单中的外国人！
根据要求，警务处长获准驱逐名单中包含的人员，其中以下人员已被逮捕：Bernard Goldfar, S. Confmann, F. T.
